news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹12.43 (up from ₹1.98 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹16.0b (up 21% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹4.03b (up ₹3.55b from FY 2025). Profit margin: 25% (up from 3.6% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was primarily driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) surpassed analyst estimates by 11%. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Hospitality industry in India.

news.title: The Leela Palace Jaipur Unveils the Amber Terrace, Its New Rooftop Destination Overlooking the Aravallis
news.body: The Leela Palace Jaipur unveils The Amber Terrace - a refined rooftop destination where heritage, flavour and contemporary indulgence come together in effortless harmony. Conceived as a sensory experience rather than just a venue, The Amber Terrace captures the spirit of Jaipur - a city where the old and the new coexist with striking ease - and reinterprets it for the modern global traveler. At the heart of The Amber Terrace lies its distinctive 'Root to Fruit' philosophy - an inventive cocktail and culinary programme that draws inspiration from Rajasthan's indigenous produce and botanical heritage. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.54. Net income: ₹1.48b (up ₹1.48b from 3Q 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 4.7%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 19%. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Hospitality industry in India.
